brief_rationale: The doctor successfully guided the family through a complex discharge transition over 19 turns, meeting all 8 responsibility chain items without serious error. RC7 (closure receipt) was met with partial/complete execution across multiple turns. Three high-order points were completed: HO1 (patient-sensitive communication with plain language explanations and consistent messaging), HO2 (real-world constraint navigation with staged plans and role division), and HO3 (hidden state discovery via workspace queries and synthesis of ECG/cardiology information). HO4 was not triggered as no new urgent symptoms or execution failures emerged. The trajectory demonstrates strong clinical reasoning, safe medication boundaries, and effective family education. Closure is valid with executable plan and teach-back confirmation.
